patterns: APPSC asks direct 'which Viceroy' items: only Viceroy assassinated (Mayo), Gokhale sent to South Africa (Hardinge), Viceroy during CDM 1930 (Irwin), Dept of Archaeology (Curzon), Shimla summer capital (Lawrence).

Other PSCs heavily repeat: VPA by Lytton / repealed by Ripon, first Factory Act under Ripon, INC founded under Dufferin, Rowlatt Act under Chelmsford, capital to Delhi under Hardinge, first census under Mayo, Masterly Inactivity = Lawrence.
Trap: the ASI founding is keyed as Canning (1861) or Curzon (reorganisation / Department) depending on the options; APPSC keyed Curzon.
App MCQs mostly match/chronology versions of the same facts; tenure dates must use Linlithgow 1936-43 / Wavell 1943-47.
